title: Noida admin issues Chhath Puja advisory, urges devotees to avoid deep water
description:
The Gautam Buddh Nagar administration has issued a safety advisory for Chhath Puja, urging devotees to use only designated puja sites and ghats, avoid entering deep waters and remain alert to prevent accidents and other emergencies during the festival.
Additional District Magistrate (Finance and Revenue) Ajit Kumar Singh appealed to residents to celebrate the festival in a safe, peaceful and orderly manner, saying large gatherings were expected at various ghats, ponds, rivers and other water bodies.
The District Disaster Management Authority has issued a set of precautions, asking devotees not to venture into prohibited or deep-water areas and to ensure that children are not left unattended near water bodies.
The advisory also calls for avoiding overcrowding, pushing and situations that could lead to a stampede. People have been asked to exercise caution while using lamps, incense sticks and other inflammable materials, and maintain a safe distance from electrical wires, temporary .
